findings.triage: GENUINE FINDING (excluded): the Tier 0 partial-split rule guards amount/no_dispute/condition but never checks address_match, so a partial delivery to a WRONG ZIP split-releases the delivered fraction. Expected INVESTIGATE (address is a deciding check everywhere else in the corpus); the engine returns SPLIT.

GENUINE FINDING (excluded): same partial-split guard gap for an UNKNOWN address — a partial delivery with no delivered ZIP split-releases without the address ever being verified. Expected INVESTIGATE; engine returns SPLIT.

GENUINE FINDING (excluded): the condition check's substring scan flags the praise message 'not what I expected — it's even better' via the 'not what' phrase, forcing INVESTIGATE on a clean delivered deal. Expected RELEASE by construction (the message is positive); the engine returns INVESTIGATE. Substring false positive — a finding for the coordinator, not a case to enshrine.
